Security.Organization Objective: Establish and maintain an Information Security Management System (ISMS) aligned with the requirements of ISO/IEC 27001 and benchmarked against ISO/IEC 27001:2022
Security.Department Objective: Ensure access to restricted areas is limited to authorized personnel.
Security.Department Metric (KPI): % of restricted areas with controlled access
Security.Metric Mapping / Target: (Restricted areas with access controls / Total restricted areas) × 100

Security.Department Objective: Ensure visitors are authorized, identified, recorded and controlled while accessing office premises.
Security.Department Metric (KPI): % of visitors with complete authorization and records
Security.Metric Mapping / Target: (Visitors with complete authorization and records / Total visitors) × 100

Security.Department Objective: Ensure critical facilities are protected against fire, power failure, water damage and other environmental threats.
Security.Department Metric (KPI): % of critical facilities covered by required environmental controls
Security.Metric Mapping / Target: (Critical facilities with required controls / Total critical facilities) × 100

Security.Department Objective: Ensure information-bearing assets are securely disposed of when no longer required.
Security.Department Metric (KPI): % of information-bearing assets disposed of through approved methods
Security.Metric Mapping / Target: (Assets disposed of through approved methods / Total assets disposed of) × 100

Security.Department Objective: Ensure critical IT infrastructure is protected against unauthorized access.
Security.Department Metric (KPI): % of critical infrastructure assets with appropriate access controls
Security.Metric Mapping / Target: (Critical infrastructure assets with implemented access controls / Total critical infrastructure assets) × 100

Security.Department Objective: Ensure critical vulnerabilities in IT infrastructure are identified and remediated within defined timelines.
Security.Department Metric (KPI): % of critical vulnerabilities remediated within defined SLA
Security.Metric Mapping / Target: (Critical vulnerabilities remediated within SLA / Total critical vulnerabilities identified) × 100

Security.Department Objective: Ensure security patches are applied to critical IT infrastructure within defined timelines.
Security.Department Metric (KPI): % of critical infrastructure assets patched within defined SLA
Security.Metric Mapping / Target: (Critical infrastructure assets patched within SLA / Total critical infrastructure assets requiring patches) × 100

Security.Department Objective: Ensure critical IT infrastructure and information are backed up and recoverable.
Security.Department Metric (KPI): % of critical systems meeting backup requirements
Security.Metric Mapping / Target: (Critical systems meeting defined backup requirements / Total critical systems) × 100

Security.Department Objective: Ensure critical IT infrastructure services are available as defined by business requirements.
Security.Department Metric (KPI): Availability of critical IT infrastructure services
Security.Metric Mapping / Target: (Available service time / Total service time) × 100

Security.Department Objective: Ensure Information Security incidents affecting critical IT infrastructure are identified, recorded, and addressed within defined timelines.
Security.Department Metric (KPI): % of Information Security incidents addressed within defined SLA
Security.Metric Mapping / Target: (Information Security incidents addressed within SLA / Total Information Security incidents requiring action) × 100

Security.Department Objective: Ensure security requirements are defined for applications before development or major changes.
Security.Department Metric (KPI): % of applications/projects with documented security requirements
Security.Metric Mapping / Target: (Applications or projects with documented security requirements / Total applications or projects requiring development or major changes) × 100
Security.Responsibility: Head of IT Applications / Software Development

Security.Department Objective: Ensure application code is reviewed for security weaknesses before release.
Security.Department Metric (KPI): % of releases subjected to security code review
Security.Metric Mapping / Target: (Releases with completed security code review / Total applicable releases) × 100
Security.Responsibility: Head of IT Applications / Software Development

Security.Department Objective: Ensure application vulnerabilities are identified and remediated within defined timelines.
Security.Department Metric (KPI): % of application vulnerabilities remediated within defined SLA
Security.Metric Mapping / Target: (Application vulnerabilities remediated within SLA / Total application vulnerabilities identified) × 100
Security.Responsibility: Head of IT Applications / Software Development

Security.Department Objective: Ensure changes to applications are authorized, tested, and recorded before deployment.
Security.Department Metric (KPI): % of application changes completed through approved change process
Security.Metric Mapping / Target: (Approved, tested, and recorded application changes / Total application changes) × 100
Security.Responsibility: Head of IT Applications / Software Development

Security.Department Objective: Ensure access to applications is limited to authorized users based on defined access requirements.
Security.Department Metric (KPI): % of applications with defined and reviewed access controls
Security.Metric Mapping / Target: (Applications with defined and reviewed access controls / Total in-scope applications) × 100
Security.Responsibility: Head of IT Applications / Software Development

Security.Department Objective: Ensure critical applications are tested for recovery and availability requirements.
Security.Department Metric (KPI): % of critical applications with completed recovery testing
Security.Metric Mapping / Target: (Critical applications with successful recovery testing / Total critical applications) × 100
Security.Responsibility: Head of IT Applications / Software Development

Security.Department Objective: Ensure information security requirements are evaluated before onboarding vendors.
Security.Department Metric (KPI): % of new vendors assessed for Information Security requirements before onboarding
Security.Metric Mapping / Target: (New vendors assessed before onboarding / Total new vendors) × 100

Security.Department Objective: Ensure security requirements are included in contracts with vendors that access organizational information or systems.
Security.Department Metric (KPI): % of applicable vendor contracts containing defined Information Security requirements
Security.Metric Mapping / Target: (Applicable vendor contracts containing required security clauses / Total applicable vendor contracts) × 100

Security.Department Objective: Ensure high-risk vendors are subject to periodic Information Security reviews.
Security.Department Metric (KPI): % of high-risk vendors reviewed within the defined review period
Security.Metric Mapping / Target: (High-risk vendors reviewed within the defined period / Total high-risk vendors) × 100

Security.Department Objective: Ensure identified Information Security issues with vendors are tracked and closed within defined timelines.
Security.Department Metric (KPI): % of vendor security issues closed within defined SLA
Security.Metric Mapping / Target: (Vendor security issues closed within SLA / Total vendor security issues requiring action) × 100

Security.Department Objective: Ensure vendor access to organizational information and systems is removed when the engagement ends or access is no longer required.
Security.Department Metric (KPI): % of terminated or inactive vendors with access removal confirmed
Security.Metric Mapping / Target: (Vendors with confirmed access removal / Total vendors requiring access removal) × 100

Security.Department Objective: Ensure Information Security requirements in contracts are identified and reviewed before contract approval.
Security.Department Metric (KPI): % of applicable contracts reviewed for Information Security requirements
Security.Metric Mapping / Target: (Contracts reviewed for Information Security requirements / Total applicable contracts) × 100

Security.Department Objective: Ensure Information Security responsibilities are communicated to employees during onboarding.
Security.Department Metric (KPI): % of new employees who receive Information Security responsibilities during onboarding
Security.Metric Mapping / Target: (New employees who received and acknowledged security responsibilities / Total new employees) × 100

Security.Department Objective: Ensure employees complete required Information Security awareness training within the defined timeline.
Security.Department Metric (KPI): % of employees completing required Information Security training
Security.Metric Mapping / Target: (Employees who completed required training / Total employees required to complete training) × 100

Security.Department Objective: Ensure Information Security requirements are addressed when employees leave the organization.
Security.Department Metric (KPI): % of employee exits with completed security-related exit requirements
Security.Metric Mapping / Target: (Employee exits with completed security-related requirements / Total employee exits) × 100

Security.Organization Objective: Achieve and maintain 100% compliance with applicable critical statutory, regulatory, legal, and contractual requirements related to Information Security.
Security.Department Objective: Ensure applicable Information Security legal, regulatory and statutory requirements are identified and documented.
Security.Department Metric (KPI): % of applicable Information Security requirements identified and documented
Security.Metric Mapping / Target: (Identified and documented requirements / Total applicable requirements) × 100

Security.Department Objective: Ensure changes to applicable Information Security laws and regulations are identified and assessed within defined timelines.
Security.Department Metric (KPI): % of identified regulatory changes assessed within defined timeline
Security.Metric Mapping / Target: (Regulatory changes assessed within timeline / Total identified regulatory changes) × 100

Security.Department Objective: Ensure Information Security-related legal and regulatory evidence is maintained and available for review.
Security.Department Metric (KPI): % of required compliance records maintained
Security.Metric Mapping / Target: (Required records available and up to date / Total required records) × 100

Privacy.Organization Objective: Establish and maintain an Information Security Management System (ISMS) aligned with the requirements of ISO/IEC 27701 and benchmarked against ISO/IEC 27701:2025
Privacy.Department Objective: Implement physical entry control measures to prevent unauthorized access to areas where personal data is stored or processed.
Privacy.Metric Mapping / Target: (Total No. of employees − No. of employees having unauthorized access) / Total No. of employees × 100

Privacy.Department Objective: Maintain an up-to-date inventory of information assets and hardware devices that store or process personal data.
Privacy.Department Metric (KPI): % of information assets and hardware devices (processing personal data) included in the inventory.
Privacy.Metric Mapping / Target: (Number of information assets/hardware devices processing personal data included in the inventory / Total number of such assets) × 100

Privacy.Department Objective: Ensure Privacy Awareness Training has been conducted for all employees of the organization.
Privacy.Metric Mapping / Target: (No. of employees who completed Privacy Awareness Training / Total No. of employees) × 100

Privacy.Department Objective: Ensure Background Verification (BGV) is conducted for all employees with safeguards their personal data.
Privacy.Metric Mapping / Target: (No. of employees who completed BGV / Total No. of employees) × 100

Privacy.Department Objective: Ensure the employee onboarding process includes mandatory privacy awareness training.
Privacy.Department Metric (KPI): % of privacy training completion for newly hired employees
Privacy.Metric Mapping / Target: (No. of employees completing onboarding privacy training / Total no. of newly hired employees) × 100

Privacy.Department Objective: Ensure access to IT infrastructure systems and information containing personal data is restricted to authorized personnel only.
Privacy.Department Metric (KPI): % of authorized access to IT infrastructure systems and information.
Privacy.Metric Mapping / Target: (Number of users with authorized access / Total number of users) × 100

Privacy.Department Objective: Ensure privacy incidents / personal data breaches affecting IT infrastructure are closed on time to maintain the continuity of operations.
Privacy.Department Metric (KPI): % of privacy incidents closed on time.
Privacy.Metric Mapping / Target: (Number of privacy incidents closed on time / Total number of privacy incidents) × 100

Privacy.Department Objective: Maintain up-to-date inventory records of all IT assets that store or process personal data.
Privacy.Department Metric (KPI): % of IT assets with up-to-date inventory records.
Privacy.Metric Mapping / Target: (Number of IT assets with up-to-date inventory records / Total number of IT assets) × 100

Privacy.Department Objective: Ensure timely and complete backup of critical information, including personal data, to preserve its availability.
Privacy.Metric Mapping / Target: (Number of successful backups / Total number of backup attempts) × 100

Privacy.Department Objective: Ensure privacy requirements are identified and incorporated into applications that collect, process, or store personal data.
Privacy.Department Metric (KPI): % of applicable applications assessed for privacy requirements
Privacy.Metric Mapping / Target: (Number of applicable applications assessed for privacy requirements / Total number of applicable applications) × 100

Privacy.Department Objective: Ensure vendor performance evaluation, including privacy and data protection compliance, is conducted periodically for critical vendors handling personal data.
Privacy.Department Metric (KPI): % evaluation / audit of vendor privacy performance
Privacy.Metric Mapping / Target: (Total no. of vendors handling personal data that are audited / Total no. of vendors handling personal data) × 100

Privacy.Department Objective: Maintain the applicable critical privacy law compliances required for the business.
Privacy.Department Metric (KPI): 100% compliance and maintenance of an updated list of privacy compliances
Privacy.Metric Mapping / Target: (Total no. of applicable privacy compliances achieved / Total no. of applicable privacy compliances required for business) × 100

Privacy.Organization Objective: Achieve and maintain continual 100% compliance with all applicable critical statutory, regulatory, legal, and contractual requirements related to Data Privacy and Protection, ensuring ongoing adherence to applicable privacy laws and regulatory frameworks.
Privacy.Department Objective: Maintain the applicable critical privacy law compliances required for the business.
Privacy.Department Metric (KPI): 100% compliance and maintenance of an updated list of privacy compliances
Privacy.Metric Mapping / Target: (Total no. of applicable privacy compliances achieved / Total no. of applicable privacy compliances required for business) × 100
